description:
Home office tax deduction for a New Zealand business run from home.

    Use for: 'home office square metre rate nz', 'ird square metre rate 2026', 'home office
    deduction calculator nz', 'how much home office can I claim', 'home office mortgage
    interest claim nz', 'working from home expenses self employed nz'.

    Inland Revenue's square metre rate: $57.30 for the 2026 income year, $55.60 for 2025,
    $53.10 for 2024, $51.05 for 2023, $47.85 for 2022, $44.75 for 2021. It covers energy,
    phone and internet and insurance; mortgage interest, rates and rent are claimed on top
    by floor-area share. 15 m2 of a 150 m2 home with $22,000 of premises costs: $2,200
    plus $859.50 = $3,059.50.

    Args:
        office_area: Square metres used mainly for business.
        total_area: Total floor area of all buildings on the property.
        premises_costs: Mortgage interest, rates and rent for the year.
        running_costs: Power, insurance, phone, internet, repairs for the year.
        marginal_tax_rate_percent: 10.5, 17.5, 30, 33 or 39.
        income_year: 2021 to 2026 (year ending 31 March).

    Returns:
        The deduction and tax saved under the square metre rate and the actual cost method.
name: nz_home_office_rate_calculator
